title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 37 - Infinite Stamina

preimages.meaning: 中文：强制耐力条件帮助函数返回真。 / English: Force the stamina-condition helper to return true.
中文：跳过低于上限分支，使耐力上限值始终写回。 / English: Skip the below-maximum branch so the maximum stamina value is always written back.

known_risks: 中文：同时强制耐力上限写回和耐力条件返回真；请验证奔跑、翻滚、格挡与水下动作。 / English: Forces both max-stamina writeback and the stamina condition result; verify sprinting, rolling, guarding, and underwater actions.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #37“耐力无限”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #37 "Infinite Stamina" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
